name: Devin
what_it_is: Autonomous cloud software engineer running each session in a dedicated Cognition VM with v3 REST API and Devin CLI.
programmatic_control: Devin API v3: start `POST /v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions`, list `GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions`, archive/stop `POST /v3/organizations/{org_id}/sessions/{devin_id}/archive` (legacy v1 `/v1/sessions` still available during deprecation) (https://docs.devin.ai/api-reference/v3/sessions/post-organizations-sessions, https://docs.devin.ai/api-reference/getting-started/migration-guide); Devin CLI cloud sessions & `/handoff` (https://docs.devin.ai/cli/cloud.md).
auth_method: API key (v3 service user token `Bearer cog_...` or personal access token; legacy v1 `apk_user_...`); Devin CLI login
usage_or_limits: Enterprise API: `GET /v3/enterprise/consumption/*` and `GET /v3/enterprise/metrics/*` (https://docs.devin.ai/api-reference/getting-started/migration-guide); self-serve usage/quota in Settings > Usage & limits (no self-serve usage endpoint verified; unverified).
pricing_model: Free tier ($0, local/light quota); Devin Cloud from Pro $20/mo, Teams $80/mo (up to 100 users), Max $200/mo, plus on-demand credits at API pricing; Enterprise billed in ACUs (https://devin.ai/pricing, https://docs.devin.ai/admin/billing/usage).
os_platforms: Cloud VMs on Linux (Ubuntu), Windows (~9% higher usage), and macOS; web, Devin Desktop, Devin CLI (macOS/Linux), Slack, Teams, Linear, Jira, GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/ADO.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (and optional harness row for local Devin CLI)
fit_reason: Complete org-scoped v3 session lifecycle API, multi-OS cloud VMs, enterprise consumption endpoints, and an existing OpenWiz driver effort.

name: Cursor Cloud Agents
what_it_is: Cursor's hosted cloud coding agents running in isolated Ubuntu VMs (or self-hosted worker pools) with a public beta REST API.
programmatic_control: Cloud Agents API v1 (public beta, base `https://api.cursor.com`): start `POST /v1/agents`, list `GET /v1/agents`, inspect `GET /v1/agents/{id}`, follow-up/steer `POST /v1/agents/{id}/runs` (supports `delivery: "steer"`), check run `GET /v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}`, stream `GET /v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}/stream`, delete/stop `DELETE /v1/agents/{id}` (https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/api/endpoints, https://cursor.com/docs/api).
auth_method: API key (Basic or `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`, user or service account key from Cursor Dashboard -> API Keys)
usage_or_limits: Enterprise Admin API (`/teams/filtered-usage-events`, `/organizations/filtered-usage-events`) and Analytics API (https://cursor.com/docs/api); individual usage endpoint unverified.
pricing_model: Free tier ($0, limited local/chat); Plus $8/mo (Grok models); Cloud Agents included from Premium $30/mo and Super $100/mo, with third-party models billed separately at API list price (https://cursor.com/pricing).
os_platforms: Cursor-managed Ubuntu cloud VMs or self-hosted worker pools/machines; Cursor editor (macOS/Windows/Linux), web, iOS, Slack, Linear, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (and harness row via Cursor CLI)
fit_reason: First-class v1 REST API with create, steer/follow-up, SSE streaming, delete, multi-forge Git support, and huge developer adoption.

name: OpenAI Codex Cloud
what_it_is: OpenAI's managed cloud coding workspace in ChatGPT that runs Codex tasks in isolated containers against connected GitHub/GitLab repos.
open_source: partial (Codex CLI is Apache-2.0 at https://github.com/openai/codex; Codex Cloud service is proprietary)
programmatic_control: CLI (experimental): `codex cloud` (alias `codex cloud-tasks`) to browse/execute cloud tasks and `codex apply` (alias `codex a`) to apply diffs locally (https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli/reference); no public standalone HTTP REST API for ChatGPT Codex Cloud (use OpenAI Agents API for API-key cloud runs).
auth_method: ChatGPT OAuth / `codex login` (ChatGPT subscription required for Codex Cloud; API-key auth runs local CLI only)
usage_or_limits: none via public API (shared ChatGPT plan usage limits viewed in ChatGPT UI; CLI usage subcommand unverified).
pricing_model: No free cloud tier; included in ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo), Pro ($100/$200/$500/mo tiers reported; verify current plan selector), Business ($25/user/mo monthly or $20/user/mo annual), and Enterprise (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/cloud).
os_platforms: Managed Linux cloud containers (up to 4 vCPU / 16 GiB; offline by default during agent phase); ChatGPT web, desktop (macOS/Windows), mobile, Codex CLI (macOS/Linux/Windows), Linear, Slack.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (via `codex cloud` CLI) and harness row (via local `codex exec`)
fit_reason: Massive ChatGPT subscriber reach and included compute, though experimental CLI-only cloud control and lack of an HTTP API limit headless fleet reliability.

name: OpenAI Agents API
what_it_is: OpenAI's hosted stateful agent runtime API (`openai_hosted` sandbox environments) for starting, streaming, steering, and cancelling multi-turn cloud agent sessions.
open_source: no (proprietary service; official Python/TS/Go/Java SDKs are open source)
programmatic_control: OpenAI SDK / REST beta: start `client.beta.agents.sessions.create({agent, environment: {type: "openai_hosted"}, input, stream: true})`, send follow-up/steer `client.beta.agents.sessions.events.create(sessionId, ...)` with turn lifecycle events `agent.session.turn.completed`, `agent.session.turn.failed`, `agent.session.turn.cancelled`, plus webhooks and scheduled automations (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions).
auth_method: API key (`OPENAI_API_KEY` Bearer token)
usage_or_limits: Standard OpenAI Organization Usage & Costs API (exact agent-sandbox billing endpoint breakdown unverified).
pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go API token pricing plus hosted environment metering; no free tier (exact sandbox rate unverified).
os_platforms: OpenAI-hosted Linux sandbox environments; any client via REST/Python/TypeScript/Go/Java SDKs.
fit_reason: Official API-key-authenticated hosted agent runtime with durable sessions, steering, streaming, and webhooks — fills the programmatic gap left by ChatGPT Codex Cloud.

name: Claude Code in the Cloud
what_it_is: Anthropic's hosted cloud sessions for Claude Code running in managed VMs (or beta self-hosted runners), triggered from web, mobile, desktop, GitHub, or `claude --cloud`.
programmatic_control: CLI: start parallel cloud sessions with `claude --cloud "<prompt>"` (alias `--remote`) and pull into terminal with `claude --teleport` (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web); no standalone REST stop/poll endpoint for consumer claude.ai web sessions (for full API control, see Claude Managed Agents).
auth_method: Claude account OAuth / `claude` CLI login (GitHub App required for repository access)
usage_or_limits: none via public API (shares Claude Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise plan usage limits in app/CLI UI).
pricing_model: No free cloud tier; included in Claude Pro ($20/mo), Max ($100/mo), Team, and Enterprise plans with no separate VM surcharge (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web, https://claude.com/pricing).
os_platforms: Anthropic-managed Linux VMs (~4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM) or self-hosted runners (beta); web, desktop, iOS/Android, CLI (macOS/Linux/Windows), GitHub events, Slack (Team/Enterprise).
openwiz_plug_in: driver (via `claude --cloud` CLI) and harness row (via local `claude -p`)
fit_reason: Zero-extra-compute-cost cloud execution for millions of Claude Pro/Max users, but one-way CLI handoff and limited programmatic stop/inspect APIs make Managed Agents stronger for fleets.

name: Claude Managed Agents
what_it_is: Anthropic's API-first hosted agent harness running Claude in managed (or self-hosted) sandboxes with bash, file editing, web, MCP, SSE streaming, and scheduled runs.
open_source: no (proprietary service; official SDKs are open source)
programmatic_control: REST API (beta header `anthropic-beta: managed-agents-2026-04-01`) & official SDKs / `ant` CLI: define `POST /v1/agents` & `/v1/environments`, start `POST /v1/sessions` (`client.beta.sessions.create`), check `GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}` & `client.beta.sessions.events.list`, steer/interrupt via `user.interrupt` event, stop/terminate `POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/archive` (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/sessions, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/session-operations, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/http/beta/sessions/archive).
auth_method: API key (`x-api-key` Claude Console API key; or server API key on self-hosted Managed Agents; also on AWS & Google Cloud)
usage_or_limits: Per-session spend caps via `max_list_cost` on session create/update (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/session-operations); Anthropic Console Admin Usage API for org totals.
pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go API token + managed runtime billing on Claude API (no free tier; exact sandbox per-minute rate unverified).
os_platforms: Anthropic-managed cloud Linux sandboxes, self-hosted sandboxes, or full self-hosted Managed Agents server; any client via REST/Python/TS/Go/Java/C# SDKs or `ant` CLI.
fit_reason: Cleanest first-party stateful cloud agent API from Anthropic with full create/event/interrupt/archive control, budget caps, and self-hosted parity.

name: GitHub Copilot Cloud Agent
what_it_is: GitHub's autonomous background coding agent running in GitHub cloud sandboxes or Actions runners, controllable via REST Agent Tasks API, GraphQL issue assignment, and Copilot SDK cloud sessions.
open_source: no (proprietary service; `@github/copilot-sdk` client SDKs are open source)
programmatic_control: Agent Tasks REST API (public preview, `https://api.github.com`): start `POST /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/tasks`, list `GET /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/tasks` or `GET /agents/tasks`, check `GET /agents/repos/{owner}/{repo}/tasks/{task_id}` (states: `queued`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `failed`, `idle`, `waiting_for_user`, `timed_out`, `cancelled`) (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/agent-tasks/agent-tasks, https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/cloud-agent/use-cloud-agent-via-the-api); stop via GitHub UI / Actions run cancellation (REST cancel endpoint unverified); Copilot SDK Cloud Sessions `client.createSession({ cloud: { repository } })` + `session.send({ prompt })` (https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/copilot-sdk/features/cloud-sessions).
auth_method: OAuth / Fine-grained PAT / GitHub App user-to-server token (`Authorization: Bearer`, permission `Agent tasks: write`; server-to-server installation tokens not supported) or logged-in Copilot CLI
usage_or_limits: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API for Business/Enterprise orgs; personal AI Credits balance/alerts in GitHub Copilot settings (personal credit-read endpoint unverified) (https://github.com/features/copilot/plans).
pricing_model: Free tier ($0, no cloud agent); Cloud Agent included from Copilot Pro $10/mo ($15 total GitHub AI Credits, $0.01/credit), Pro+ $39/mo ($70 credits, adds third-party Claude/Codex preview agents), Max $100/mo, Business $19/user/mo, Enterprise (https://github.com/features/copilot/plans).
os_platforms: GitHub cloud sandboxes, GitHub Actions runners (Linux, 59-min cap), or remote custom environments; GitHub.com, mobile, VS Code/JetBrains/Xcode/Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, SDKs (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), Linear, Slack, Teams, Jira.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (and harness row via Copilot CLI)
fit_reason: Native GitHub integration, official REST Agent Tasks API plus 6-language SDK cloud sessions, and lowest paid entry price ($10/mo Pro).

name: Factory (Droids & Droid Computers)
what_it_is: Agent-native software development platform running Droid agents on managed persistent cloud computers (`Droid Computers`), local CLI, or BYO machines with full OpenAPI control.
programmatic_control: Factory Public API (`https://api.factory.ai`, OpenAPI at https://docs.factory.com/openapi.json): start `POST /api/v0/sessions` or one-shot `POST /api/v0/droid/execute`, list/check `GET /api/v0/sessions`, `GET /api/v0/sessions/{sessionId}`, `GET /api/v0/sessions/{sessionId}/messages`, wake/message `POST /api/v0/sessions/{sessionId}/messages`, stop `POST /api/v0/sessions/{sessionId}/interrupt` & `DELETE /api/v0/sessions/{sessionId}`, manage VMs `POST/GET/DELETE /api/v0/computers` (https://docs.factory.com/api-reference, https://docs.factory.com/api-reference/sessions.md, https://docs.factory.com/api-reference/droid.md); also Droid CLI (`droid exec`) and TypeScript SDK (https://docs.factory.com/sdk/typescript).
auth_method: API key or user JWT (`Authorization: Bearer $FACTORY_BEARER_TOKEN`, optional `X-Factory-Org-Id` header); Droid CLI login
usage_or_limits: API: `GET /api/billing/limits` and org limit endpoints `GET/PUT /api/v0/organization/usage/limits/{global,groups,shared,users}` (https://docs.factory.com/openapi.json).
pricing_model: Free tier ($0, bring your own inference via ChatGPT/Copilot/OpenRouter/API keys); Pro $20/mo, Plus $100/mo, Max $200/mo, Teams $60/mo + $40/seat, Business & Enterprise custom (https://factory.com/pricing).
os_platforms: Managed Linux cloud computers (e.g., E2B-backed) or BYO machines; Factory desktop app (macOS/Linux), Droid CLI, web, Slack, Teams, Linear, Jira, Google Chat.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (cloud Sessions/Execute API and local Droid CLI harness row)
fit_reason: Complete OpenAPI for sessions, headless execute, interrupt/delete, computer lifecycle, AND programmatic billing/usage limit endpoints.

name: GitLab Duo Agent Platform
what_it_is: GitLab's generally available multi-agent SDLC platform running Developer Flow (issue-to-MR), Code Review Flow, and custom agent flows in GitLab-managed/CI environments.

name: Linear Cloud Coding Agent

name: Alibaba Qoder Cloud Agents

usage_or_limits: Cloud Agents Credits consumption tracked in personal/enterprise Qoder spaces (https://docs.qoder.com/cloud-agents/billing); programmatic credit endpoint unverified.
pricing_model: Prepaid Cloud Agents Credits for personal spaces; per-seat Teams/Enterprise subscriptions with Service Account Dedicated Credits and shared add-on credits (exact USD rates unverified; https://docs.qoder.com/cloud-agents/billing, https://docs.qoder.com/account/enterprise/pricing).
os_platforms: Alibaba Cloud managed sandboxes; Qoder IDE/CLI, REST API.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (and harness row for Qoder CLI)
fit_reason: Serious managed cloud agent API from Alibaba Cloud with service-account auth and event streaming, though docs/pricing outside China and exact stop endpoints need verification.

name: Cloudroom
what_it_is: Cloud workspace and desktop IDE that runs 10+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, OpenCode, Devin, Droid, Hermes, Antigravity, etc.) in isolated cloud sandboxes with your own subscriptions or keys.
open_source: partial (desktop app advertised as open source at https://www.cloudroom.dev; repository URL and SPDX license unverified; cloud backend proprietary)
programmatic_control:
CLI (`room-cli`): start `room-cli thread spawn --provider

--prompt ` or `room-cli thread fork`, check `room-cli thread show [ID]`, `room-cli thread list`, `room-cli thread output `, `room-cli thread log `, `room-cli thread wait --children`, wake `room-cli thread tell `, stop `room-cli thread stop ` / `room-cli thread archive`, plus `room-cli loop` and `room-cli wake` (https://www.cloudroom.dev, https://www.cloudroom.dev/docs/faq).
auth_method: CLI login / Cloudroom app account (agents inside threads use your own Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, Devin subscriptions or API keys)

os_platforms: Cloud Linux sandboxes (plus optional GPU rental); desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux; `room-cli`.
openwiz_plug_in: driver (already available as an OpenWiz v1 driver)
fit_reason: Already proven as an OpenWiz v1 driver with complete CLI spawn/show/tell/stop/usage control, zero token markup, generous free tier, and 10+ agent harnesses.

name: Warp Oz (Warp Factories)
what_it_is: Warp's programmable cloud agent platform running Warp Agent, Claude Code, or Codex in Warp-hosted Docker sandboxes or self-hosted workers with full OpenAPI and `oz` CLI.

pricing_model: Free tier ($0, limited cloud agents, BYOK supported); Build $20/mo ($20 agent usage at API rates), Max $200/mo ($200 usage), Business $50/user/mo (up to 25 seats, $20/seat usage), Enterprise custom; cloud agent compute also metered per agent-hour + inference (https://www.warp.dev/pricing).
os_platforms: Warp-hosted Linux Docker sandboxes or self-hosted workers; Warp terminal/CLI (macOS, Linux, Windows), web, Slack, Linear, Jira, GitHub.

name: OpenHands Cloud

name: Amp (Amp Orbs)

usage_or_limits: none verified via CLI/API (unverified; orb spawn pacing enforced server-side).

name: Tembo
what_it_is: Cloud agent orchestration platform running Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Amp, and Pi in dedicated Linux VMs triggered by API, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Linear, Jira, Slack, or Sentry.
programmatic_control: Tembo REST API (`https://api.tembo.io`, plus TypeScript SDK, Rust SDK, and OpenAPI-generated MCP server): start `POST /v1/sessions`, list `GET /v1/sessions`, interrupt/stop `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/stop` (optional `cancelQueued=true`), archive/stop VM `DELETE /v1/sessions/{sessionId}` (https://docs.tembo.io/api/index.md, https://docs.tembo.io/api/v1/sessions/stop-a-session, https://docs.tembo.io/api/v1/sessions/delete-a-session); `tembo` CLI connects local machines as devices.
